# ClickTp

**Category:** Movement  
**Aliases:** Click Tp, Click TP, ClickTP, ClickTp

## What it does

ClickTp lets you instantly teleport to whatever block you are aiming at. Look at a spot within reach, press your middle mouse button (the "pick block" key), and you'll be moved on top of the targeted block. While you aim, the block you're pointing at is highlighted — green means it's a valid landing spot, red means you can't teleport there. A spot counts as valid when it's a solid block you can stand on with enough open headroom above it, so you won't try to land inside a wall or ceiling.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/exploit/clicktp). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
